findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (passed 66-47)
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading of HB 958. The ratified bill requires county boards to process a registration only if the applicant states they are a U.S. citizen (with a 30-day sworn-statement fix when the answer is blank), and requires the State Board of Elections to create a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database. It also changes deceased-voter removal. Bill page: https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958 ; ratified text: https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf
subjects: removing possible non-citizens from voter rolls
